title: Explore Five Stunning Tri Pointe Homes During This Year's Triangle Parade of Homes

# Explore Five Stunning Tri Pointe Homes During This Year's Triangle Parade of Homes


Tri Pointe Homes


•


August 20, 2026


Share this article


Tri Pointe Homes® is proud to showcase five thoughtfully designed homes during the[2026 Triangle Parade of Homes](https://hbawake.com/Home-Tours/Parade-of-Homes) . Hosted by the[Home Builders Associations of Raleigh-Wake County and Durham, Orange & Chatham Counties,](https://hbawake.com/) the Parade of Homes gives home shoppers the chance to tour some of the area's most innovative new homes. Open to the public, this annual event is a great opportunity to discover your next floorplan, explore new home designs or simply gather inspiration from the latest trends in home décor and technology.


From communities designed for active adults to homes that are perfect for young professionals and growing families, each featured home highlights the craftsmanship and flexible floorplans that define the Tri Pointe Homes experience.


[The Ryder Model at Twinleaf Townes | Chapel Hill](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/twinleaf-townes/ryder-178624)


The Ryder Model at Twinleaf Townes is sure to become the go-to home for neighborhood get-togethers and celebrations. This three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath townhome was made for entertaining, featuring a gourmet kitchen with a large island, generous counter space and a walk-in pantry. A twelve-foot sliding glass door opens to a beautiful deck, making it easy to enjoy indoor-outdoor living while hosting guests. The first floor also includes a flexible room that can serve as a home office, guest suite or optional bedroom, along with a full bath and convenient drop zone off the garage. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features two walk-in closets, while the secondary bath includes a double vanity for added convenience.


Total Price: $569,990


[About Twinleaf Townes](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/twinleaf-townes) :


Priced from the $400K’s


3-4 Beds | 3-4 Baths | 2098- 2317 sq. ft. | 2 Bay Garage | 3 Story Townhome


Twinleaf Townes offers low-maintenance townhome living in a location that puts its residents close to many of the Triangle’s[most popular destinations](https://www.visitchapelhill.org/things-to-do/) . Just minutes from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and Research Triangle Park, this community makes it easy to commute, explore downtown Chapel Hill or spend time taking in the natural beauty that the nearby parks and greenways have to offer.[Top-tier healthcare](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/duke-university-unc-hospitals-ranked-among-nations-best-in-2025-26-report/) and easy access to a variety of shopping, dining and entertainment make it easy for residents to enjoy all the conveniences of Triangle living.


[Sampson at Townes at NoVi | Pittsboro](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/the-townes-at-novi/sampson-205534)


The Sampson, a three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath townhome, pairs an open-concept layout with practical spaces that make everyday life a little easier. The spacious kitchen, complete with a large island, flows naturally into the main living area to create a comfortable gathering space . A two-bay rear-load garage and drop zone help keep daily routines organized, while the second-floor loft provides extra room for movie nights, a playroom or a cozy retreat. The upstairs also includes a spacious primary suite and two additional bedrooms, making it easy to accommodate guests or a home office.


Total Price: $439,990


[About Townes at NoVi :](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/the-townes-at-novi)


Priced from the $300K’s


3 Beds | 2.5 Baths | 1724- 1814 sq. ft. | 2 Bay Garage | 2 Story Townhome


Townes at NoVi brings modern townhome living to Pittsboro, a charming Triangle community. Located just a short drive from Chapel Hill, the community offers the aesthetic of small-town living while keeping residents connected to major employers, local restaurants, shopping and outdoor recreation. Residents get to enjoy living in[Chatham Park](https://chathampark.com/) with the[Mosaic district](https://www.mosaicatchathampark.com/) just a few minutes away, with access to more than 30 miles of greenways, as well as a swim and pickleball club that makes it easy to stay active and connected! With its convenient location and low-maintenance lifestyle, Townes at NoVi is a great fit for first-time homebuyers, busy professionals and anyone looking to enjoy all that Pittsboro has to offer.


[Oak Haven at Altis™ at Serenity | Fuquay-Varina](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/the-grove-collection-at-serenity/oak-haven)


For those looking for the ease of single-level living, the Oak Haven brings together comfort, flexibility and thoughtful design. This two-bedroom, ranch-style home, designed for active adults looking to embrace this exciting next chapter of life, features an open-concept layout that extends into a spacious covered outdoor living area, creating a comfortable place to relax. A versatile flex room can easily become a home office, hobby room, guest suite or quiet reading retreat. Residents can also personalize the home with options like a gourmet kitchen layout, an expanded outdoor living space and an optional fireplace, making it easy to create a home that fits their lifestyle.


Total Price: $539,990


[Foxtail Manor at Altis™ at Serenity | Fuquay-Varina](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/the-meadows-collection-at-serenity/foxtail-manor)


With nearly 3,000 square feet of living space, the Foxtail Manor offers plenty of room to spread out while still enjoying the convenience of single-level living. Its open layout makes everyday life feel comfortable, while a flexible front room can be used as a home office, cozy den or guest room. A spacious covered outdoor living area extends the home's living space, creating a great spot to enjoy your morning coffee or spend time with guests. For home shoppers who want even more room, an optional second-floor loft provides additional space for work, overnight guests or hobbies.


Total Price: $799,990


[About Altis™ at Serenity](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/altis-at-serenity) :


Priced from the low $400K’s


2-4 Beds | 2-3 Baths | 1281- 3290 sq. ft. | 2 Bay Garage | 1-2 Story Homes


Designed exclusively for adults aged 55 and better, Altis™ at Serenity offers a lifestyle centered around connection, wellness and low-maintenance living. The community features beautifully designed ranch-style homes alongside resort-inspired amenities including a new clubhouse, currently under construction, that will feature a pool, fitness center and yoga studio. Residents can also enjoy social gathering spaces and opportunities to spend time outdoors. Located in Fuquay-Varina, Altis™ at Serenity offers a welcoming environment where residents can spend less time on maintenance and more time enjoying the activities, hobbies and connections that matter most.


[The Ellis Model at Summit at Homestead | Chapel Hill](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/summit-at-homestead)


The Ellis is a comfortable two-story home designed for everyday life. The open main floor centers around a spacious kitchen with a large island that naturally brings people together, whether you're making dinner, helping with homework or catching up at the end of the day. Upstairs, a loft provides extra space to relax, while the primary suite and two additional bedrooms, each with a walk-in closet, offer plenty of room for guests.


Total Price: $589,990


[About Summit at Homestead](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/summit-at-homestead) :


Priced from the $400K’s


3-4 Beds | 2-3 Baths | 1767- 2146 sq. ft. | 1-2 Bay Garage | 2 Story Townhome


Located just minutes from downtown Chapel Hill, Summit at Homestead offers thoughtfully designed townhomes in a peaceful setting with convenient access to everyday essentials. Residents can enjoy the[Pumpkin Trail](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/us/north-carolina/pumpkin-loop) at their doorsteps,[highly rated schools](https://www.greatschools.org/north-carolina/chapel-hill/#College_success) and the vibrant dining, shopping and cultural attractions that make Chapel Hill one of the[Triangle's most desirable places to live](https://www.niche.com/places-to-live/search/best-places-to-live/m/raleigh-metro-area/) . With modern home designs and a location that keeps everything within easy reach, Summit at Homestead offers a comfortable place to call home.


**Experience the Tri Pointe Difference**


Every Tri Pointe home is designed to make everyday living more comfortable, connected and enjoyable. Throughout each parade home, visitors will find open floorplans that encourage gathering, flexible spaces that adapt to changing needs, designer-selected finishes and carefully considered details that make each home feel both functional and inviting.


The featured homes also showcase Tri Pointe Homes' LivingSmart® program, which includes energy-efficient construction, healthier building practices and integrated smart home technology designed to enhance comfort while supporting a more sustainable lifestyle.


Whether you're drawn to the charm of Chapel Hill, the growing community of Pittsboro or the active adult lifestyle in Fuquay-Varina, there's a Tri Pointe home waiting to inspire you during this year's Triangle Parade of Homes.


We invite you to tour all five featured homes, meet our team and experience firsthand the innovative design, quality craftsmanship and livability that makes each Tri Pointe Home Life-Changing by Design™.
